notes.title: New update (features & bug fixes)
notes.content:
Another small update

New features:
[list]
    [*]Player lasers/projectiles now pass through friendly players (as well as Corby and other friendly bots). Should alleviate some of the get-out-of-my-way frustrations!
    [*]Global leaderboard leader is now displayed in Arcade Mode player select screen.
    [*]Player/controller select now works a bit differently, so Player1 isn't forced to use the first controller, and any player can use the keyboard/mouse

[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
    [*]Fixed extreme slowdown on some Windows10 machines, when gamepads were connected
    [*]Online-multiplayer: Fixed camera issue when 2 players attempt to revive Corby at the same time
    [*]Fixed teleporter problem on Level 7 when playing local co-op

[/list]

If you're enjoying the game, don't forget to leave a review! If you have any feedback , be sure to post a message on the community page :)

notes.title: Crash bug fix
notes.content:
There's an update now available which should fix a nasty memory-leak bug that would cause the game to crash after a fixed amount of time. It seemed especially bad on Windows10 machines, where it would reliably crash the game within 30 minutes(!!!) So sorry for any frustration this may have caused...

Thanks to those who reported it, let me know if there's still any issues...

notes.title: Online multiplayer, demo version, and more!
notes.content:
The latest update includes online multiplayer. It's still in BETA, but now in the main version of the game (not the beta branch)

There's also a bunch of other fixes, including improved mouse/keyboard controls (popup inventory on RMB, so no more awkward key combinations!). We also speeded up projectiles a little (by popular demand!)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24757573/0dc73a0cad938ef6d1e9e3e9e97702f78b36976b.png[/img]


For those still on the fence, a free demo version of the game is now available - click the "Download Demo" on the store page. 

Last but not least, work continues on a brand new game mode, featuring procedurally generated levels. Not 100% sure yet when this will go live, but hopefully it will be something that will see ongoing updates, with new content and features. We'd love to hear feedback on the kind of things you'd like to see in this game mode.

notes.title: Online multiplayer beta is here!
notes.content:
The long awaited online multiplayer beta has arrived! This means you can now play Story & Arcade co-op modes online with friends. To give it a try, right click 'properties' on Dual Core in Steam, go to the 'Betas' tab, and select "publicbeta".

To start an online game, you should proceed as if you were going to play normally (currently 'Versus' mode isn't supported), but select "online (beta)" from the character select screen. This will allow you to browse and/or create online games. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24757573/bb218f1b13d1d9cd082108f49fea677666d49f9e.png[/img]

There was a lot of work involved in this update(!), so it's very possible that there are still a few bugs present (hence it being a beta). I'll be fixing these as I find them, or as you report them, but the ones I'm most interested in hearing about right now, are issues with being able to create or connect to games. Let me know of any problems! (and watch out for pesky firewalls blocking internet access to the game)

Network lag/latency is always going to be a tricky issue with an arcade-y game like Dual Core, but hopefully I've been able to minimise its effects. 

Once I'm sure everything is reasonably reliably, and I haven't introduced any game breaking bugs(!) I'll bring the new features across to the main version.

In addition, this beta version includes some udpated mouse controls, which hopefully imrpoves the use of inventory when using keyboard/mouse. You can now use RMB to bring up an inventory popup.

notes.title: Wish list features for Dual Core
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I was wondering what features you'd be most interested in seeing added to Dual Core. Here are a few suggestions of what I *could* spend time adding. Obviously some of these are a bigger deal than others, and I can't do them all at once, but let me know what you think!

[list]
[*] Online multiplayer
[*] Procedurally generated levels - via a new game mode (it might be fun to do this as an ongoing beta, with your involvement over the direction it heads)
[*] Melee combat (as opposed to ranged combat) characters
[*] Mac & Linux versions
[*] new content ( enemies, weapons etc)
[*] other!
[/list]

What would you like to see first? Let me know!

notes.title: Update: new upgradeable "Speed" stat, future melee characters
notes.content:
The latest update introduces a new stat on the upgrade screen: "Speed/Agility"

Upgrading this will improve your max speed, and acceleration. Have fun!  

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24757573/2ce0f7028aeb752cee4c4bda1ec084ea1f5a866e.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24757573/8df0a7aab3d54d81da655c9a948c252bb18d6b2c.gif[/img]  

Finally... if you're enjoying Dual Core, [b]don't forget to tell your friends, and leave a review![/b] It's hugely appreciated and helps get the game a little bit more visibility. Thanks so much!

notes.title: Small bug fix update
notes.content:
I just uploaded small update that should fix a number of issues.

Bug fix: elevator levels sometimes won't finish, forcing you to restart them
Bug fix: inventory would sometimes display wrong icon
Bug fix: prevent issue where player 2 could finish the level without player 1, causing problems with Corby in the next level if you switch to single player mode.
Balancing: Arcade level 4 is now easier!
Balancing  tweaks to some bosses, enemy damage, health etc.

notes.title: Latest update:
notes.content:
Thanks to those who've bought the game! Be sure to leave a review if you're enjoying it!

The last couple of updates made some balancing changes, and some minor bug fixes.

[list]
[*]Balancing: Tweaks to difficulty on later levels - it's now slightly harder late in the game.
[*]Balancing: Changes to drop rates for powerups.
[*]Balancing: chnages to help prevent loot exploit from enemy spawners.
[*]Bug fix: wrong achievements being granted for arcade mode (off by one!)
[*]Bug fix: fix rare issue where inventory would vanish, and become unusable.
[*]Bug fix: Show UI hint to break ice on frozen companions - it wasn't always displayed previously.
[/list]
